title: Normalized presentation of the integral condensed coefficient tower
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite intermediate extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a uniformizer $\pi$ of $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use $A=\operatorname{ULift}\mathcal O_E$ only to match the original small pro-etale site's coefficient universe. Define $I=(\operatorname{up}\pi)$ and the adic datum $d$ with this actual ideal [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]; the named arithmetic well-definedness theorem verifies Noetherianity, finite generation, torsion, finiteness and perfectness of its positive quotients. Define the actual two-term free complex as the cone of multiplication by $\pi^{n+1}$ on $A[0]$, the quotient complex $(A/I^{n+1})[0]$, and HasFiniteFreeTerms as the conjunction of Mathlib Module.Free and Module.Finite in every degree. For any scheme $T$, reconstruct section rings $R_T,R_{T,n}$ of its pulled-back condensed $\mathcal O_E$ and $\mathcal O_E/\pi^{n+1}$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], [sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x], [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence], and the specified quotient maps. A coefficient model consists of ring isomorphisms $R_T\cong d.\widehat A_T$ and $R_{T,n}\cong d.(A/I^{n+1})_T$, commuting with every quotient projection and taking a local constant class of $a$ to the class of $\operatorname{up}a$. Its internal-module equivalence is the existing section-module equivalence followed by scalar restriction along that completed-ring isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-module-encoding]; its derived equivalence is induced termwise. Define finite fixed-scalar encoding by restriction along the canonical constants-to-functions ring isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], followed by the canonical constant-ring module restriction [lem-sfb-constant-scalar-restriction-tensor], and define its exact derived functor. In the same adic coefficient coordinates define quotient Roos completeness to mean the distinguished Roos triangle with first map the specified completion unit [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] followed by the product of canonical derived projections [def-sfb-completed-rlim-roos-projection]. This is the augmented quotient-tower condition of [def-weil-derived-complete], transported in coefficient coordinates, not a definition by invertibility of a unit. The sheafification instances specialize the existing small-site module-universe instances.
